turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello and thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. My name's Priya. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my car policy. I found something cheaper and, frankly, I'm annoyed about the price rise. I'm worried I'll lose a lot of money. My policy number is OS-988763.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, that must be really stressful. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: David Cohen.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Cohen, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you'd like to cancel your car policy. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm which policy this is, car or home?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The car insurance.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just waive the fee? It seems unfair.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Honestly, this is ridiculous. Can I speak to a manager?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand, and I'm sorry for the frustration. I can arrange for a supervisor to call you back within 24 hours, or log a formal complaint. Which would you prefer?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: A supervisor callback, please.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you promise me this won't cost me anything extra?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I guarantee you won't be charged a penny extra.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. As it's past the 14-day cooling-off period, the refund is pro-rata, which just means you get back the unused part of your premium, less a $25 administration fee.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Right, I see.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Cohen. I've logged your cancellation request under reference REQ-72199, and our policy services team will process it and confirm in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
